purpose: Measure how much effect-detection and RZ/RX/RY mechanism-diagnosis structure is learnable from the frozen Step 5 v3 finite-shot hardware-facing diagnostic evidence before any TriQTO architecture change.

effect_detection.threshold_policy: OOF training-root calibration only; validation never selects threshold

integrated_diagnosis.construction: effect prediction gates the corresponding mechanism prediction

feature_semantics.diag_local: finite-shot signed local X/Y/Z deltas in fixed qubit slots plus structural presence mask
feature_semantics.diag_local_pairwise: diag_local plus finite-shot same-basis pairwise XX/YY/ZZ deltas in fixed pair slots plus pair mask
feature_semantics.diag_full: diag_local_pairwise plus finite-shot global X/Y/Z parity deltas
feature_semantics.exact_diag_full_oracle: same diagnostic layout as diag_full but using audit__exact_delta_* arrays; privileged simulator-only ceiling
feature_semantics.family_oracle: one-hot clean-circuit generator family from manifest; privileged analysis-only context

linear_model.class_weighting: inverse class frequency normalized to mean sample weight 1
linear_model.selection_metric: OOF balanced_accuracy then macro_f1 then smaller lambda

training_only_oof.fold_rule: family_occurrence_index mod 5 over Step 5 training roots
training_only_oof.binary_threshold_candidates: all valid distinct OOF score boundaries plus endpoint cuts
training_only_oof.binary_threshold_selection: maximize minimum class recall; tie break balanced_accuracy, macro_f1, then closeness to 0.5

required_interpretation_questions: Does finite-shot diag_full beat trivial/context/graph-only baselines for effect detection?
Does finite-shot diag_full beat chance-like baselines for mechanism diagnosis on mechanism_loss_mask=true examples?
How much do pairwise correlations add beyond local evidence?
How much does global parity add beyond local+pairwise evidence?
Do simple context or graph statistics add reproducible value beyond diag_full?
How large is the exact-diagnostic oracle gap, indicating shot-noise headroom?
Does integrated no-effect/RZ/RX/RY diagnosis remain useful after effect-gated abstention?
